top_band: snowy roof from rows 1 to 8 (white and pale blue-grey bands), plus elliptical well rim and dark interior opening from rows 16 to 23
evidence: The well shows both a 3/4 pitched snow-covered roof (rows 1-8) overhanging the wooden supports (eave beam at row 9) and a clear elliptical well opening below (back rim row 16, dark interior rows 17-22, front rim row 23) above a 7-row brick front face (rows 24-30).

style.evidence: Compared directly to the reference well next to it, the candidate's stonework (rows 23-30) is a repetitive flat grey grid with only 2 grey tones and a dark mortar line, lacking the multi-value individual stone shading of the reference. The bucket is a flat 2-colour rectangle without hoop or plank detail, and the wooden posts have much simpler shading.
